promptText: When an owner wants a collection or soft-brand option for a hotel conversion in Mexico, which brands are commonly considered?
rawText:
If a hotel owner in Mexico is pursuing a **conversion** or **soft-brand affiliation**, they’re likely focusing on retaining their property’s unique character while benefiting from a global brand’s distribution, loyalty programs, and operational platforms. Here are the most commonly considered soft‑brand or collection‑brand options across the major hospitality companies—relevant and familiar to the Mexican market:

Hilton
- Curio Collection by Hilton (upscale lifestyle)
- Tapestry Collection by Hilton (upscale lifestyle)
These allow independent-style hotels to join Hilton’s system with more design flexibility and local flair. ([hospitalitas.com.mx](https://hospitalitas.com.mx/2022/07/28/entendiendo-el-modelo-de-negocio-de-las-soft-brands-hoteleras/?utm_source=openai))

Marriott International
- Autograph Collection (upscale to upper upscale lifestyle)
- Tribute Portfolio (upscale lifestyle)
- Design Hotels (luxury lifestyle)
These collections offer partners flexibility in aesthetics and storytelling while connecting to Marriott’s reservation channels and loyalty programs. ([hoteldevelopmentguide.com](https://hoteldevelopmentguide.com/hotel-brands/?utm_source=openai))

Hyatt
- Unbound Collection by Hyatt (luxury lifestyle)
This series caters to unique, independent hotels, inviting them to maintain distinct identities within Hyatt’s infrastructure. ([hospitalitas.com.mx](https://hospitalitas.com.mx/2022/07/28/entendiendo-el-modelo-de-negocio-de-las-soft-brands-hoteleras/?utm_source=openai))

Wyndham Hotels & Resorts
- Trademark Collection
- Registry Collection Hotels
- Dolce Hotels and Resorts  
These brands target upscale to luxury independent properties, providing soft brand options that emphasize individuality and property-specific appeal. ([development.wyndhamhotels.com](https://development.wyndhamhotels.com/convert-your-existing-hotel?utm_source=openai))

Accor
- MGallery (upscale to luxury lifestyle)
- Emblems Collection (luxury lifestyle)
These soft brands wrap independent-style hotels in Accor’s global distribution and marketing while preserving boutique character. ([hoteldevelopmentguide.com](https://hoteldevelopmentguide.com/hotel-brands/?utm_source=openai))

IHG Hotels & Resorts  
Particularly relevant to Mexico, given active development and conversions in the region:

- Vignette Collection (luxury & lifestyle, conversion‑friendly)
- voco hotels (premium conversion brand, flexible identity)
- Ruby (premium urban lifestyle, adaptive reuse and conversions)
- Kimpton Hotels (lifestyle brand suitable for conversions)
- Hotel Indigo (lifestyle, neighborhood-driven, flexible styling)
- Crowne Plaza (upscale, sometimes used in conversions)
- Noted Collection (new premium collection brand focused on conversions, launched in early 2026)
IHG has seen strong growth from these brands in Mexico and Latin America, and numerous conversion projects are already underway or planned. ([costar.com](https://www.costar.com/article/1775490468/soft-brands-conversions-drive-ihg-hotels-resorts-growth-in-caribbean-latin-america?edition=us&utm_source=openai))

Other Operators  
- **Preferred Hotels & Resorts** (a soft-brand approach, independent luxury properties, active globally including U.S.‑based affiliation) ([hospitalitas.com.mx](https://hospitalitas.com.mx/2022/07/28/entendiendo-el-modelo-de-negocio-de-las-soft-brands-hoteleras/?utm_source=openai))  
- Regional or emerging operators such as **OYO** or **Dot Hotels** (more budget to mid‑market independent hotels) may offer soft‑brand models in Latin America, but they are less prominent for higher-end conversions in Mexico. ([hospitalitas.com.mx](https://hospitalitas.com.mx/2022/07/28/entendiendo-el-modelo-de-negocio-de-las-soft-brands-hoteleras/?utm_source=openai))

Summary Table (Overview)

- Hilton: Curio, Tapestry  
- Marriott: Autograph, Tribute, Design Hotels  
- Hyatt: Unbound Collection  
- Wyndham: Trademark, Registry, Dolce  
- Accor: MGallery, Emblems Collection  
- IHG: Vignette Collection, voco, Ruby, Kimpton, Hotel Indigo, Crowne Plaza, Noted Collection  
- Others: Preferred Hotels & Resorts, select regional operators

If you're considering a conversion in Mexico, IHG’s **voco**, **Vignette Collection**, and **Ruby** (along with the newly launched **Noted Collection**) are particularly active and conversion‑friendly in the region. However, global chains like Marriott, Hilton, and Wyndham also offer strong soft-brand collection models that suit independent-style conversions across various segments.
